美军在阿曼湾击伤试图突破对伊封锁的货船

US Military Says It Disabled Cargo Vessel in Gulf of Oman

The US military said it disabled a cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman on 7 November, with a US aircraft firing a precision munition at the stern of a St Kitts and Nevis-flagged cargo ship after it visited an Iranian port and ignored repeated warnings while trying to breach the naval blockade on Iran. Washington also announced a task force to counter Iran’s transfer of advanced weapons and sanctioned goods via land and Caspian routes, and estimates the blockade has stopped more than $25bn of Iranian oil exports.

美军中央司令部称，美军飞机 11 月 7 日在阿曼湾向一艘圣基茨和尼维斯籍货船船尾发射精确弹药并使其失去动力，该船在访问伊朗港口后无视多次警告，试图突破美国对伊朗的海军封锁。美方同时宣布成立专责小组，打击伊朗经陆路和里海转移先进武器及受制裁物资；美方估计封锁已阻止伊朗出口逾 250 亿美元原油。

02安全与地缘 · 2026年11月8日

伊朗称两艘油轮在霍尔木兹触雷起火，格什姆岛等地传出爆炸声

Iran Says Two Tankers Hit Mines and Caught Fire in Hormuz as Blasts Heard on Qeshm

Explosions were heard on Saturday evening, 7 November, on Qeshm Island and in Jask, Sirik and Bandar Abbas, Iranian state television reported. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards Navy said early on Sunday, 8 November, that two oil tankers had caught fire after hitting mines while trying to pass through an “unauthorised route” in the Strait of Hormuz, with their navigation systems switched off. Iranian officials have not confirmed any missile strikes, and a Tasnim source said the Qeshm blasts were not missile-related; the Iranian claims have not been independently verified by maritime agencies, and the tankers were not identified.

伊朗国家电视台报道，11 月 7 日晚间格什姆岛、贾斯克、锡里克和阿巴斯港等地听到爆炸声。伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队海军 11 月 8 日凌晨称，两艘油轮在试图经“未经授权航线”通过霍尔木兹海峡时触雷起火，船只关闭了导航系统。伊朗官员未确认导弹袭击，塔斯尼姆通讯社引述消息称格什姆岛的爆炸与导弹袭击无关；伊朗方面的说法未经独立海事机构核实，涉事油轮身份未披露。

Bulk Carrier in Incident with Military Forces in Gulf of Oman, UKMTO Says

A bulk carrier was involved in an incident with military forces about 18 nautical miles east of Khor Fakkan, UAE, the UK Maritime Trade Operations office said, with the crew’s condition, damage and environmental impact unknown at the time. IMO：霍尔木兹冲突以来至少 25 名船员遇难，袭击达 130 起

At Least 25 Seafarers Killed in Strait of Hormuz Since Conflict Began, IMO Says

At least 25 seafarers have been killed in the Strait of Hormuz since the conflict began on 28 February, with 130 attacks on merchant shipping, the IMO said; the latest victim was a crew member of the Velos Sapphire, attacked on 5 November, and thousands of seafarers remain stranded in the Gulf. The IMO Council, at its 138th session from 2–6 November, reaffirmed its commitment to protecting seafarers facing mounting threats and approved funding for a major digital platform upgrade.

国际海事组织（IMO）称，自 2 月 28 日冲突爆发以来，霍尔木兹海峡针对商船的袭击已达 130 起，至少 25 名船员遇难，最新的遇难者为 11 月 5 日遭袭的 Velos Sapphire 号船员；另有数千名船员滞留波斯湾。IMO 理事会第 138 届会议（11 月 2–6 日）重申保护面临日益严峻威胁的船员，并批准重大数字平台升级资金。

Oil Traders Shun Russian Diesel as Tankers Divert After Trump-Putin Deal

At least three tankers carrying Russian diesel bound for the US have diverted — the Talisman into the Mediterranean, the Leruo to Brazil, and a third changing its destination from New York to “await orders”. New Jersey’s governor has warned port operators against unloading, while Russia’s envoy called the diversion reports “fake news”.

Ningbo-Zhoushan Targets $157m Stake in Brazilian Container Terminal

China’s Ningbo-Zhoushan Port is bidding for a combined 10.73% stake in Xinda Resources, the holding company of the TCP container terminal at Brazil’s Port of Paranaguá, at a floor price of RMB1.11bn (about $157m) via a public sale on the Beijing Equity Exchange; its board approved the bid on 6 November. China Merchants Port, which holds 77.45% of Xinda, has waived its right of first refusal. TCP handled 1.66m teu in 2025.

中国宁波舟山港拟通过北京产权交易所公开竞价，收购巴西帕拉纳瓜港 TCP 集装箱码头控股公司 Xinda Resources 合计 10.73% 股权（两笔分别为 8.91% 和 1.82%），底价 11.1 亿元人民币（约 1.57 亿美元），董事会已于 11 月 6 日批准。持有 Xinda 77.45% 股权的招商局港口已放弃优先购买权；TCP 码头 2025 年处理 166 万 TEU。

Hutchison Expands Vessel Handling Capacity in Sydney

Hutchison Ports Sydney has brought two new ship-to-shore container cranes (Quay Cranes #5 and #6) into operation at its Port Botany terminal, built to serve vessels of more than 15,000 teu — well above the roughly 9,000 teu of the largest ships currently calling in Australia — with outreach across 23 container rows and lifting over nine tiers high. Hapag-Lloyd Completes 25% Stake Purchase at Rotterdam Terminal

Hapag-Lloyd has completed its acquisition of a 25% stake in APM Terminals Maasvlakte II in Rotterdam, via its Hanseatic Global Terminals division, following unconditional antitrust approval; financial terms were not disclosed. 16法规与安全 / 船员 · 2026年11月7日

加纳与加拿大签署海员证书互认协议

Ghana and Canada Sign Seafarer Certificate Recognition Agreement

Ghana and Canada have signed an agreement for the mutual recognition of seafarers’ certificates of competency, signed at IMO headquarters in London by Ghana Maritime Authority director-general Kamal-Deen Ali and Transport Canada’s Joanna Manger, under Regulation I/10 of the STCW Convention. It could open employment for Ghanaian officers on Canadian-flagged ships and covers cooperation on certificate verification and training compliance; no start date for applications was specified.

加纳与加拿大在伦敦 IMO 总部签署海员适任证书互认协议，由加纳海事局局长 Kamal-Deen Ali 与加拿大交通部海事安全与保安总干事 Joanna Manger 签署，依据 STCW 公约第 I/10 条。协议可能为加纳籍高级船员在加拿大籍船舶上就业打开机会，并涵盖证书核查与培训合规合作；何时开始受理申请未说明。

17法规与安全 / 船员培训 · 2026年11月7日

IMO 将 LNG 燃料船培训项目扩展至马来西亚

IMO Expands LNG Ship Training Programme to Malaysia

Maritime trainers from Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines and Viet Nam completed a subregional train-the-trainer workshop in Japan (22–30 October) so they can upskill seafarers working on LNG-fuelled ships, covering LNG properties, cryogenic hazards, gas detection, bunkering simulator training and emergency response. The workshop starts the second phase of an IMO–Japan project to build regional LNG training capacity, in line with STCW/IGF Code mandatory training requirements for seafarers on LNG-fuelled ships.

来自马来西亚、印度尼西亚、菲律宾和越南的海事培训师在日本完成了区域培训师培训研讨会（10 月 22–30 日），学习如何培训在 LNG 燃料船上工作的海员，内容包括 LNG 特性、低温危害、气体探测、加注模拟与应急响应。这是 IMO 与日本合作的第二阶段项目，旨在提升区域 LNG 培训能力，符合 STCW 公约与 IGF 规则对 LNG 燃料船海员的强制培训要求。
